name: beautiful-embedded-c
description: Skills for writing, reviewing, and porting deterministic, safety-critical Embedded C with Claude.

plugins.name: beautiful-embedded-c
plugins.description: Skills that teach Claude to write, review, and port idiomatic Embedded C across all firmware layers (app, bsp, config, drv, libs, ISRs, RTOS tasks), distilled from six authoritative reference digests including RTOS & ISR framework conventions, plus drop-in clang-format/clang-tidy/architecture lints, dual-target CMake and Make build configs, and multi-layer scaffolding.
